title: Rooftop solar inventory
capture: Frozen aerial survey {dates}. The building inventory contains model observations of visible photovoltaic panels.

metrics.roof_area_estimates: Buildings with a roof-parallel area estimate

map_caption: Green dots show observed PV buildings. Brown outlines show registry postcode areas. No basemap.
grouping: Building-supported image groups are merged by ALKIS building ID. The union counts overlapping detections once and retains source group IDs and capture dates.
lod2: Detected PV is intersected with each usable LoD2 roof face. Area correction assumes the modules sit parallel to that face. Flat roofs, insufficient face support and inconsistent geometry use projected area for scoring.
registry_scope: The complete MaStR snapshot dated {snapshot} contains {records:,} records across {zones} municipal postcode rows. The table shows active anonymous rooftop PV records with capacity below 30 kW.
candidate_coverage: {listed:,} of {eligible:,} image-stage targets have geographic candidates. At least one roof scored {minimum} points or more for {ranked:,} targets. All candidate roofs scored below that threshold for {low:,} targets. Independent evidence confirms {verified} building identities.
postal_method: The model considers roofs in the registered municipality and an unambiguous LGB postcode. It scores area, direction and tilt. Post-capture targets contribute to postcode totals.
gis: The EPSG:3035 GeoPackage includes observed PV buildings, roof faces and registry postcode totals. The registry_building_candidates table retains a top-five score preview.
sources: Imagery, ALKIS, LoD2 and postcodes © GeoBasis-DE/LGB, dl-de/by-2-0. Registry © Bundesnetzagentur/MaStR, dl-de/by-2-0.
joint_proposals: The delivery map shows {proposals:,} joint matches and {coordinates:,} public-coordinate associations. The joint model prevents duplicated array claims and applies shared roof capacity. Building identities remain unverified.
